# YouTube Shorts Agent

Agent-first YouTube Shorts upload CLI and MCP server.

Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/youtube-shorts-agent
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/youtube-shorts-agent
Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=youtube-shorts-agent -- youtube-shorts-agent doctor
MCP command: youtube-shorts-mcp

Core tools:
- youtube_agent_manifest
- youtube_connection_status
- youtube_privacy_audit
- youtube_oauth_authorize_url
- youtube_upload_short
- youtube_list_recent_videos

Safety:
- Dry-run is enabled by default.
- OAuth tokens are never returned to agents.
- AI-generated uploads default to containsSyntheticMedia=true.
